desc: Keep game speed when the GPU falls behind, with a GPU that keeps up: Rogueport's plaza at 60 frames a second and 480 lines, real timing (no TTYD_FAST), no added delay. The game runs its 60 frames a second, every one drawn, and nothing is caught up or left out. Real timing on the machine: in the perf group, as a machine loaded by other games (frames costing more than a field) is a GPU that falls behind
